description: Header file defining the Controller class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace, including nested classes, interface implementations, and method declarations related to plugin control, web interface, and subsystem management.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main plugin controller class implementing multiple plugin and system management interfaces, handling plugin lifecycle, web requests, subsystem configuration, and notifications.

classes.name: Controller::SubsystemsData
classes.description: JSON container class representing subsystem data with active status.

classes.name: Controller::Config
classes.description: Configuration class containing probe settings, resumes, subsystems, and UI flag.

classes.name: Controller::ProbeConfig
classes.description: Nested class within Config for probe-specific settings like TTL and node address.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service object.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles delete requests for plugin resources.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts device discovery with specified TTL.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates a plugin with a timeout.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a request token and method.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method call with parameters.

methods.name: FromIdentifier
methods.description: Gets a plugin service from a callsign.

methods.name: Callstack
methods.description: Retrieves call stack data for a thread.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a plugin based on a base callsign.
